qa.what_happened: I had to enforce stricter discipline tonight due to ongoing silence issues, particularly with prisoner 9304 who seemed increasingly agitated. The study was stopped early, likely because the tension and discomfort became too significant.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking and enforcing the rules as a guard.

qa.what_happened: I found myself going through another day in the study, with frequent reminders to maintain silence and compliance. The monotony and strict rules felt suffocating, especially as the guards emphasized the importance of these rules multiple times.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 1442.

qa.what_happened: During the final day of the study, everything went smoothly as usual. The prisoners remained silent during meals and work details, and there were no disruptions before lights out. The lead researcher asked if I had any concerns or observations, to which I responded that the routine was becoming monotonous.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me enforcing the rules and maintaining order as Officer Lowe.

qa.what_happened: I was relieved that the study had been stopped early, as the constant emphasis on silence and order was wearing on me. The last warning from Officer Mercer made me realize just how serious the rules were taken.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me. I was the one who remained silent and complied during the work details and meal times, but also felt the strain of the study's demands.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a reiteration of the previous days, with an increased emphasis on compliance and attention from the guards. Despite the ongoing dehumanization and strict enforcement of rules, I continued to maintain silence and obedience, albeit with a growing sense of unease.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, acting as instructed during the study while reflecting on the experience.

qa.what_happened: Today's routine was punctuated by increasing tensions among the prisoners and a strict enforcement of silence by the guards. I noticed that despite our efforts, the monotony was starting to weigh heavily on us all.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the protocol to maintain order and safety, emphasizing the importance of silence and compliance.
